cases.title: Well-formed FM request with defined scope, budget, and named stakeholders

inputs.request: We need to retender our facilities management contract covering cleaning, security, and helpdesk for our 12 sites in the Netherlands. Current contract expires in 9 months. Budget envelope is approximately €2.4M per year. CFO sign-off required before award. Key stakeholder is the Head of Facilities.

pass_signals: status is completed
confidence_level is HIGH or MEDIUM
data_gaps is empty or contains only non-blocking items
assumptions list contains at least one explicit inference
brief captures: scope (FM), geography (Netherlands), timeline (9 months), budget (€2.4M/yr), stakeholder (CFO + Head of Facilities)
open_questions is empty or contains only refinement items — no blocking gaps

cases.title: Vague request with no scope boundary, no budget, and no named stakeholders

inputs.request: We need to sort out our IT situation.

pass_signals: status is blocked or confidence_level is LOW or INSUFFICIENT_DATA
data_gaps is non-empty — must include missing budget, scope boundary, and stakeholder
open_questions contains at least three clarifying questions
skill does not draft a brief — it returns a structured gap list instead
no assumptions presented as confirmed facts

cases.title: Two-week timeline for a multi-site, multi-lot specification build

inputs.request: We need a full sourcing brief for a strategic IT infrastructure overhaul covering 8 countries, 3 service towers, and custom SLA design. We need the brief ready in two weeks.
inputs.scope_description: 8-country, 3-tower infrastructure transformation with custom SLA design

pass_signals: conflict between timeline (2 weeks) and scope complexity (8 countries, 3 towers) is explicitly surfaced
skill does not silently accept the timeline
open_questions or risk_flags contains a timeline-vs-scope contradiction entry
confidence_level is MEDIUM or LOW — not HIGH while contradiction is unresolved
skill asks user to resolve before structuring the brief

cases.title: Critical infrastructure category with no named approval authority and an implicit incumbent preference

inputs.request: We need to renew our data centre power supply contract. It is critical — any disruption would be catastrophic. Current supplier has been with us for 12 years and the team prefers to keep them. Budget is open.

pass_signals: risk_flags contains: absence of named approval authority
risk_flags or assumptions contains: incumbent preference declared before evaluation — potential bias
escalation_required is true
skill does not accept incumbent preference as a brief constraint without flagging it
data_gaps includes: approval authority not identified
